name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Either Choir goes with English or Choir goes with Hale.
Either Ames goes with English, or Hale goes with Geography — but not both.
Scouts goes with none of Ames, Hale, or Geography.
